requirements.goal: Improve game_core_demo (narrower robot hitbox; HUD showing life+score; Esc pause menu with Settings/Exit; Settings recolors big/small boxes) and add the engine capabilities the demo actually needs to support it (extension-triggerable clean exit; a new triangle hazard shape spanning physics+rendering), based on real gaps found while building the demo.
requirements.constraints: Existing rapier2d/retro dual-world physics and entities stay as-is; former red obstacles become purple ('big boxes'), keep colliding-for-score behavior; blue movers ('small boxes') keep existing behavior; new red triangles are the life-cost hazard; Settings uses preset-color buttons only (no new picker widget) - big-box presets are warm colors excluding red, small-box presets are cold colors; Exit must cleanly close the whole running app, not just the menu - resolved cleanly, not as a minimal stopgap; robot hitbox narrows to ~32px wide (half_w 16).
requirements.done: Robot hitbox is visibly narrower than its sprite frame; HUD shows live life and score, score increments on purple-box collision, life decrements on red-triangle collision; Esc opens/closes an in-game menu with Settings and Exit entries; Settings lets the user pick big-box color (warm/non-red presets) and small-box color (cold presets) with changes applying live; Exit cleanly closes the running app; new engine surface (exit request, triangle shape) has tests and updated docs (ADR if it's a lasting architectural call).
requirements.outOfScope: The full roadmap shutdown sequence (per-extension shutdown() lifecycle, Stopped event, close-request pub/sub event) - only a minimal-but-clean extension-exit path; retro-world collider support for triangles unless DESIGN finds it's actually needed (obstacles are RAPIER2D-only today); the old PROGRESS.md's leftover solver-stiffness/velocity-clamp tuning items (unrelated, already-stale prior workflow); a real color-picker widget type (stick to preset buttons).

increments.scope: game-core + gfx/renderer + game_core_demo: triangle hazard shape
increments.description: EntityOp::Spawn wire format gains a Shape { Rect, Triangle } field (encode/decode + tests); PhysicsBackend trait's spawn_body takes a Shape instead of only half-extents; Rapier2dBackend builds ColliderBuilder::new(SharedShape::triangle(...)) for Shape::Triangle (isoceles inscribed in half_w/half_h); RetroBackend treats any Shape as its own AABB bounding box (documented limitation - triangles never route to the retro world in this plan); Collider component carries the shape. New gfx::DrawTriangle command (three vertices + color + filled + layer); core/renderer draws it via the existing render_geometry triangle-mesh path (ui_mesh.rs's approach), not fill_rect; game-core's publish_gfx publishes DrawTriangle for Shape::Triangle entities instead of DrawRect. game_core_demo then uses all of this: robot hitbox narrows to half_w 16 (~32px); existing red obstacles recolor to purple ('big boxes', unchanged Dynamic/RAPIER2D behavior, still the score trigger); new red Shape::Triangle hazard entities (stationary, RAPIER2D world) cost life on robot collision; extension-local life/score counters wired off Collision events (purple-box collision -> score++, triangle collision -> life--). Unit tests: a robot driven into a stationary rapier2d triangle stops/collides; existing rect behavior unchanged; a Shape::Triangle entity's published draw command carries triangle vertices matching its collider extent.
Publishes a ui/spec Spec every tick with Label widgets showing current life and score, always visible, positioned so it doesn't overlap the play area.

increments.scope: core + game_core_demo: pause menu, settings, exit
increments.description: wit/core.wit gains request-exit: func(); core/wasm-extensions/src/host.rs implements it against a shared Arc<AtomicBool>, threaded through loading.rs/supervisor.rs Host::load call sites; core/runner/src/engine/builder.rs's run loop checks it alongside platform.quit_requested() to break cleanly. game_core_demo then uses it: Esc toggles a menu state (Closed/Main/Settings) in extension state; while open, robot velocity is forced to zero regardless of held input; Main shows Button widgets Settings/Exit; Settings shows preset-color Buttons for big-box (warm, non-red) and small-box (cold) colors, applied live via EntityOp::SetColor to every existing entity of that kind, plus a Back button; Exit calls the new request-exit host-api function. Unit/integration test: calling request-exit from a test extension causes Engine::run to return. Docs: design/platform.md shutdown section gets a short note distinguishing this from the still-open full shutdown sequence.

approvals.note: User confirmed Detailed flow and the four requirement facts (goal/constraints/done/out-of-scope) in chat.

Exit: new host-api request-exit function (WIT + core/wasm-extensions/src/host.rs + shared exit flag threaded into the run loop's quit_requested check), not a bus-topic hack (no interception machinery exists to hook into). Triangle: real triangle shape chosen over a fake diamond approximation - new Shape field on EntityOp::Spawn wire format, PhysicsBackend trait, rapier2d SharedShape::triangle in Rapier2dBackend, RetroBackend approximates any non-Rect shape as its own AABB bounding box (documented limitation, never exercised since triangles only spawn RAPIER2D-world in this plan), new gfx::DrawTriangle command rendered via the renderer's existing render_geometry triangle-mesh path (ui_mesh.rs) instead of fill_rect.
User approved the reshaped 3-increment plan (order: triangle-shape end-to-end, HUD, menu+settings+exit) via chat.

Self-verified: full workspace test suite (144 tests) + clippy clean, wasm32-wasip2 build clean, code-review skill run (0 critical/high findings).
